newsitem.title: GREECE: AUTO DEALER SFAKIANAKIS TO START TRADE JUNE 18.
newsitem.headline: AUTO DEALER SFAKIANAKIS TO START TRADE JUNE 18.

text.p: Automobile dealer Sfakianakis AEBE will make its trading debut on the bourse's main market on June 18.
No daily volatility limit will be applied to Sfakianakis shares during the first three days of trading.
Sfakianakis went public at 2,000 drachmas a share and its IPO was oversubscribed 7.38 times.
The IPO tranche allocated to institutional investors was oversubscribed 9.5 times with 120 subscriptions while the retail portion was oversubscribed 6.4 times with 2,409 subscriptions.
It tapped the market for 4.25 billion drachmas with an issue of 2,125,000 common bearer shares with a par value of 300 drachmas.
IPO proceeds will be used as working capital and will finance the completion of new facilities. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
